paragraphs: Brooks Lee was the lone former Mustang to appear in a confirmed professional game on Monday, batted third and started at third base for Minnesota Twins against San Francisco Giants. Minnesota Twins fell to San Francisco Giants, 2-5.

Brooks Lee's home run — his 24th of the season came in the fourth inning on a 2-2 88 mph slider from Blade Tidwell. The swing moved the score from 0-4 to 1-4. Statcast measured the ball at 97.6 mph off the bat, a 29-degree launch angle, 387 feet.
Brooks Lee went 1-for-4, 1 home run, 1 RBI, 1 run scored.
Away from the box scores, there was also roster movement involving former Mustangs.
Derek True was activated in a roster move.
title: Brooks Lee turns around 88 mph for home run No. 24
